description: session.compact: the memory message from the observation ledger, with no model call and a manifest of the files its session touched and the key commands it ran listed by code, or a brief compiled by code where the Observer's memory cannot stand or a manual compaction has too little to observe; the kept recent messages leave out local slash commands and replies that were thinking alone, and their tool calls get fresh ids; a short first prompt is quoted with the files it names that its turn read; its Observer calls have a deadline, and it observes the rows of a background call in flight again, the first call to land standing, and an abandoned compaction installs nothing; a compaction given instructions goes to the built-in compactor; a compaction the plugin raised itself is skipped, never given to the built-in compactor, and so is one handed the context the last compaction installed, local commands aside; each main compaction installed counts toward the gauges' compaction count; prompt.section: a standing note on compaction and how to resume; ui.render: draws a collapsed memory message as one line with the context its compaction left, measured or estimated, and publishes that label for ui-extension, and hides the copies of the recent messages it kept but draws a tool line the turn's next calls joined, the /notes pane of the observations in view, and a band above the prompt with a spinner per running Observer or Reflector call of the main conversation and how each ended, and drops the spinner's stale SessionStart message once a mid-turn compaction's turn has moved on; turn.start: times the main conversation's prompts and keeps its recent turn starts; turn.step: observes a long turn mid-turn, records each main request's context, growth and cache cost, and what the prompt cache served and wrote and the context it carried on the first main request after a compaction, and writes when each main request started, or null once a compaction installs, for a status line countdown to the prompt cache's expiry; turn.complete: observes the finished turn in the background through pi, and writes the main conversation's gauges (history awaiting observation, observations toward a reflection, context toward auto-compaction, Luna's cost, the compaction count) to a file for a status line script; session.start: writes the gauges, registers om_recall, listed from the start so a compaction leaves the tool list as it was, om_stats and, when interactive, /notes and the tick of the workers band, dropping the spinners an earlier load of the code left running, and, once a day, archives to a file and prunes sessions long untouched, then the oldest until the store has room to spare; store.set: archives and prunes the oldest sessions when the store is full; tool.call: runs om_recall and om_stats, whose cost option gives the cache cost and the cheapest auto-compaction point; command.run: /om-stats, and /notes opens the observations pane, at once even mid-turn; classic.SessionStart and classic.Stop: record the transcript path; session.end: ends the loop's background work and kills its pi calls, and a /clear drops the session's state; skill.prompt: records the skills the session loads; prompt.autocomplete: offers the main session's memory lines matching a # then a word, constraints first, from an index each ledger write rebuilds; agent.spawn: adds the main session's constraints in force to a subagent's prompt, the newest within a size cap, leaving forks and workflow agents as they are
